{{Quote|Vibro. What are you doing?|The technician to Vibro|<ref name="Fury" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] aboard the destructive [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]]&mdash;a regime that formed to aid the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and its [[Five Worlds]] government in its rebellion against the Galactic Alliance&mdash;which began in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. After [[Sadras Koyan]], [[Five World Prime Minister|Prime Minister of the Five Worlds]], received a [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] transmission from [[Denjax Teppler]], the Five Worlds' [[Minister of Information (Five Worlds)|Minister of Information]], he left the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[fire-control chamber]] in an attempt to reach [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] [[Epsilon 34G]], and escape. In his absence [[Rikel (Centerpoint Station)|Vibro]] used Centerpoint to target [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], capital of the Galactic Alliance, in his desire to get revenge for his [[Rikel's wife|wife]], who had been arrested during a security sweep by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], and later found [[Death/Legends|dead]]. When the technician asked Vibro what he was doing, he responded that he was getting things ready for Koyan to fire the station, which she accepted.<ref name="Fury" />

As Galactic Alliance forces were about to enter the fire-control chamber, Vibro hissed to get her attention. He told her to watch as he pressed the button to fire the station. However, the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Toval Seyah]] had been able to reprogram the star data in the station's systems, and reset all the other coordinates as the center of [[Hollowtown]], an open sphere in the exact center of the station itself. Because of this, the station targeted itself when fired, which caused it to destroy itself from within, and killed everyone onboard.<ref name="Fury" />

==Behind the scenes==
This technician was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'', which was released on [[November 27]], [[2007]] as a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. Her [[Species/Legends|species]] is never specified.
